story.iWant: to initialize QSPI only after the bootloader completes
story.soThat: settings read/write operations don't conflict with bootloader SD card loading
story.tasks: - Implement bootloader completion delay in main() - Initialize PersistentStorage after delay - Add settings loading with version validation - Set LED state to match loaded settings - Add serial debug output for verification

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - QSPI initialization delayed until bootloader completes (use Story 1.1 recommended delay) - storage.Init() called only after delay - Settings successfully read from QSPI without corruption - No changes to existing audio processing (AudioCallback unchanged) - Firmware still boots normally and loads firmware from SD - Code compiles without errors or warnings - Follows existing code style - Binary size remains ≤ 120KB - SRAM usage < 90%
